description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractEntityIdWithRevision implementing EntityIdWithRevision. It provides core functionalities like retrieving the entity ID, revision, converting to JSON, and standard Object methods such as hashCode, equals, and toString.

classes.name: AbstractEntityIdWithRevision
classes.description: An abstract immutable class representing an entity ID with revision information, providing JSON serialization and equality checks.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JsonObject.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on entity ID and revision.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on class, entity ID, and revision.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object.
